name: High School Volunteers at Habitat for Humanity of Dane County
org: Habitat for Humanity of Dane County
what_you_do: Students volunteer at the Habitat ReStore or on home build sites. High school groups can also lead a fundraising project.
who_can_apply: Individual students ages 16 or older. High school groups can contact Habitat about a project.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact Habitat to get started.
how_to_apply: Use the Contact Us to Get Started link on the youth engagement page.
notes: The page says nothing about rules for younger teens. Contact Habitat to ask.
